## About Me

I am an **Associate Research Scientist** in the [Department of Biostatistics](https://ysph.yale.edu/public-health-research-and-practice/department-research/biostatistics/) at [Yale School of Public Health](https://ysph.yale.edu/), working with [Dr. Bhramar Mukherjee](https://ysph.yale.edu/profile/bhramar-mukherjee/). My research focuses on developing statistical methods for analyzing large-scale electronic health records (EHR) data, with particular emphasis on addressing informative visiting and observation processes.

I received my Ph.D. in Biostatistics from the [University of Texas Health Science Center at Houston](https://sph.uth.edu/divisions/biostatistics/) in 2025, where I was advised by [Dr. Ruitao Lin](https://faculty.mdanderson.org/profiles/ruitao_lin.html). My doctoral research focused on Bayesian adaptive designs for early-phase oncology clinical trials.

## Research Interests

- EHR data analysis
- Survival analysis
- Bayesian dose-finding design
- Causal inference

## Education

🎓 **Ph.D. in Biostatistics**, University of Texas Health Science Center at Houston, 2021–2025

📜 **M.S. in Statistics**, National Tsing Hua University, Taiwan, 2015–2017
